content: Hi, I received a different size than the one I ordered. Please arrange a refund for this item.
I can help with a refund for the wrong size received. Please share your user ID, registered email or phone number, and the order ID and item name.
My user ID is U012, my registered email is customer012@example.com, and the order ID is O0039 for the Cotton kurta. I ordered size M in Blue but received size L in Blue. Please arrange a refund.

I’ve confirmed that you ordered size M in Blue but received size L, so this qualifies as a wrong-item return.

I can arrange a return pickup at no charge. Your refund will be **₹1,548** (₹1,499 for the kurta + ₹49 shipping), automatically sent to your **original UPI payment method after pickup is completed**.

Shall I proceed with the return?
Yes, please proceed with the return and refund of ₹1,548 to my original UPI payment method after pickup.

Your Cotton kurta return is confirmed, and pickup has been scheduled at no charge.

**₹1,548** will be refunded automatically to your **original UPI payment method after pickup is completed**.

Return reference: **T0013**.
I’m not sure the refund has been completed; I’d need to check.

I checked order **O0039**, and **no refund is recorded yet**. Your return has been arranged; the **₹1,548 refund to your original UPI payment method** will happen automatically after pickup is completed.
I understand. Please let me know once the refund has been processed.
I can’t send a follow-up notification myself, and our policy doesn’t specify how to arrange refund alerts. I’ll pass your notification request to the support team.
